bio: Hi everyone! My name is Cindy Wang and I am from Queens, New York. I am a currently third year law student over at Harvard Law School. Before coming to Harvard, I was an English as a Second Language Teacher (ESL) at a high school in Brooklyn. I am particularly interested in education equity and immigrant justice. Outside of school, I love running, cooking, and taking my dogs, Mocha and Yuki, on long walks. My partner, Kentaro, and I are excited to meet you and be a part of your first year journey!
